verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Signals product documents on-call Schedules built from Rotations tied to teams, plus Escalation Policies for notifying via schedules or individuals, and multi-platform notifications — the core building blocks an SRE needs. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions layered/multi-tier rotations, time zone handling, or round-robin coverage patterns by name, so it's unclear whether these specific nuanced scheduling patterns are supported as described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling layers, time zone-aware rotations, and round-robin distribution logic, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of these specifics.
